CREATE INDEX idx_store_sales_ss_sold_date_sk_ss_item_sk_ss_store_sk_ss_cdemo_sk ON store_sales (ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_cdemo_sk);
CREATE INDEX idx_customer_demographics_cd_demo_sk_cd_gender_cd_marital_status_cd_education_status ON customer_demographics (cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status);
CREATE INDEX idx_date_dim_d_date_sk_d_year ON date_dim (d_date_sk, d_year);
CREATE INDEX idx_store_s_store_sk_s_state ON store (s_store_sk, s_state);
CREATE INDEX idx_item_i_item_sk ON item (i_item_sk);

SELECT 
    i_item_id,
    s_state,
    grouping(s_state) AS g_state,
    avg(ss_quantity) AS agg1,
    avg(ss_list_price) AS agg2,
    avg(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
    avg(ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM 
    store_sales
JOIN 
    customer_demographics ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
JOIN 
    date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
JOIN 
    store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
JOIN 
    item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
WHERE 
    cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary' AND d_year = 1999 AND s_state = 'TN'
GROUP BY 
    ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY 
    i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
